name: Oysters
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated in SIBO diets. Choose fresh, high-quality sources to avoid digestive irritation.
preparationTips: Steam, grill, or eat raw with lemon juice for easy digestion
Avoid breading or heavy sauces that may contain FODMAPs
Choose fresh oysters from reputable sources for food safety
Start with smaller portions if new to eating oysters
nutritionalHighlights: High in zinc and vitamin B12
Good source of iron and selenium
